item.description: (CNN) — The American Academy of Pediatrics on Monday released its updated recommendations for what vaccines children should get. item.title: Nike to lay off 775 employees as it grapples with declining sales
item.description: (Reuters) – Nike is laying off 775 employees, a source familiar with the matter told Reuters on Monday, as the sportswear giant looks to boost profits and accelerate its use of automation. item.title: 48 years later: The Blizzard of ’78 still holds snowfall records
item.description: The Blizzard of '78 was a historic winter storm that brought heavy snow, high winds, and wind chill values near -50 to Indiana, with visibility under 1/4 mile in Indianapolis for 25 straight hours.

item.title: Freezing stretch the remainder of January with multiple subzero nights | Jan. 26, 2026
item.description: Indiana is experiencing a prolonged stretch of well-below-normal temperatures with dangerous wind chill values, and the bitter arctic air is expected to persist into February.

item.title: 20 of Indiana’s 92 counties under travel warnings
item.description: Mayor Joe Hogsett has issued a travel warning for Marion County due to heavy snowfall and extremely cold temperatures, restricting travel to emergency management, public safety, healthcare workers, and other essential personnel only.

item.title: Indiana pharmacist charged in ‘astronomical’ drug theft case still holds ‘free and clear’ license
item.description: A former Muncie hospital pharmacist is facing multiple felony charges for allegedly stealing over 35,000 vials of powerful opioids, but his Indiana pharmacy license remains active and unrestricted despite the ongoing investigation.

item.title: Indiana flu deaths jump to 55, with majority 65 and older
item.description: Indiana has recorded 55 flu deaths this season, with the majority of fatalities among those 65 and older. Marion County, Indiana's largest in population, has had the most deaths of any county.

item.title: Man fatally shot at Laurelwood Apartments in Indianapolis
item.description: A man was shot and killed inside a residence at the Laurelwood Apartments on the south side of Indianapolis late Monday night, police said.

item.title: 2 die in Wayne County crash between semi and passenger vehicle
item.description: Two people died Monday night in a crash between a semitractor-trailer and a passenger vehicle on State Road 1 near Charles Road in northwestern Wayne County, Indiana.
